text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the Fan Appreciation Festival, Line 
Craft was deeply impressed by Sweep 
Tosho's performance, which completely 
defied common sense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft shares her admiration, saying 
she wants to be just like them. However, 
she is told that doing so is nothing more 
than imitating someone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And looking back on the triumphs of the 
Tiara Umamusume, she remembers something 
truly precious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What she admired was the sight of the 
Tiara Umamusume running in pursuit of 
their own unique radiance. She wished that 
she, too, could become someone others look 
up to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To blaze an untrodden path and unleash her 
own unique brilliance, Rhein Kraft aims to 
conquer both the Oka Sho and the NHK Mile 
Cup.
